text: I use the internet almost every day — look, my laptop!
Wait... is the internet ALWAYS good? Or are there bad things too?
Let's find out — together. Come on, explorer!
Whoa — the whole internet is waiting for us!
Yes! But remember our question — is it ALWAYS good? Let's keep our eyes open.
So when I send a message, it travels all the way to a global server and back?!
Exactly! Tap the glowing Data Packet to watch it travel forward and bring back the answer!
Watch how fast it zooms from my laptop to the server and returns!
Whoa! Look at all the things we can do on the internet!
And we can CREATE and play too — not just watch. Tap every building to step inside and explore!
We can learn and CREATE almost anything here. This is amazing!
It really is. But… if the internet is this powerful, could some parts be risky too?
Hmm. Let’s keep exploring and find out.
Here come different internet habits. Some are great… some, not so good.
Easy! Drag each one into GOOD CHOICE or NOT SO GOOD. Let’s sort them!
That was easier than I thought! Good and not-so-good aren’t so hard to tell apart.
Sometimes though… the SAME thing can be good OR bad. Like gaming — a little is fun, too much isn’t.
Ohh. So it’s about balance. Let’s test that next!
This is the Internet Balance Scale. Benefits on the left, risks on the right.
So if I add too many risky habits… the scale tips! Let’s test our moderation.
So the same activity can be good OR bad — it depends how much!
Exactly. Too much of anything tips the balance. The trick is moderation.
Sometimes after staring at a screen for hours, my eyes sting, get red, and I get a headache.
Let us test our 3D Vision Simulator to see exactly what happens to eyes during long screen time and how to fix it!
Welcome to the Privacy Locker! Some personal data must be locked in the Cyber Vault forever.
While other things like hobbies and avatars are fun to share. Let us sort them and see what happens!
Locked and safe! My passwords and address are guarded in the Cyber Vault forever.
And my gamer avatar is ready for the world. Let us check out Scam Alley next!
I just opened my messaging app on my laptop, and strange chat popups are appearing!
Careful Aarav! Scammers use sneaky tricks. Let us inspect each message and reply wisely!
Outstanding work! You stopped all three scam traps before they could do any harm.
Now let us see what happens when strangers message us during online gaming!
We just launched PixelQuest Arena in our digital lounge. An unknown player started messaging our avatar.
Let us deploy our live in-game privacy tools to defend our identity and safety!
All 3 stranger traps defeated! Personal identity, photo, and location stayed 100% safe!
That uncomfortable feeling is the warning alarm. Block, report, and always tell trusted adults.
Welcome to the Truth Forensic Lab! Four viral news headlines need investigation.
Let us analyze the evidence, fill our Truth & Falsehood Meters, and determine our Forensic Level!
Both meters are at 100%! We can spot fake viral stories and verify real science anytime.
Now let us see the entire global journey of the internet across our panoramic city!
LOOK AT THE ENTIRE PANORAMIC DIGITAL CITY! We can see our home, the city 5G tower, the ocean cable terminal, and our school!
Let us interactively route a data packet across the entire global internet highway!
The internet connects our whole world at the speed of light.
And we have the superpowers to use it safely and creatively. Time to seal our rulebook!
It is time to draft our 5 Golden Commandments of Digital Citizenship!
Let us seal every rule onto our classroom golden charter!
Our Golden Digital Rulebook is complete! Ready for the Final Challenge Arena!
Let us test everything we learned!
We did it! We explored the entire internet from undersea cables to cyber defense!
One final moment to seal our Master Explorer badge — let’s finish strong!
